dialog.body: Hello, thank you for contacting Old Stone Auto Insurance. My name is Zachary Smith. May I have your name, please?
Nice to meet you, Patricia! Can you please provide me with your date of birth in the format of day, month, and year separately?
Sure, my birthdate is on the tenth of October, nineteen eighty-two.
Thank you, Patricia. And may I also have the last four digits of your social security number for verification purposes, please?
Of course, the last four digits are one three four five.
Thank you for providing that information, Patricia. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that will be all. Thank you, Zachary!
You're welcome, Patricia. Thank you for reaching out to us. Have a great day!
